components.note: Convex coercive criterion, argmin set, one-sided derivatives, source midpoint convention, translation equivariance defined.
Compact interval, measurable endpoints/midpoint, equivariance, one-sided derivative characterization and score implications with full proof.
Extended population score, sign behaviour, a.s. consistency with the extended-expectation strong-law step written.
Normal limit with Lindeberg verification, sandwich for nonsmooth minimizers, B=0 case and two-half-normal source variant proved.
Conditional smooth-score theorem proved; consistency-failure example given (see defect_observations).
rho_k, psi_k, k>0, known-scale transformation and separate unknown-scale boundary.
Piecewise-affine finite computation incl. ties/flat intervals, Winsorizing identity (source Sec.4 (iii), p.79), worked numeric boundaries proved.
Symmetric contamination class, equivariant sequences, source limiting-risk order lim_C liminf_n with outer sup (source p.82).
Every symmetric H incl. cutoff atoms via half-weight A_F(k); exact worst variance V* and attainment proved.
Normalization equation (source Sec.6 Corollary, p.82), f_* membership, I_*=1/V*, score saddlepoint and Fisher-information uniqueness proved.
Finite-n finite-C information bound for all equivariant estimators proved via explicit shrinking prior.
All-translation-equivariant minimax identity (source Secs.5-6) with limit order preserved; eps=0 and k->0 median boundary proved.
Exact maximal displacement equation, attainment, eps>=1/2 unboundedness, expansion and identifiability boundary proved (source Sec.7).
Asymmetric cutoff-atom slopes, mean variance inflation, infinite finite-sample variance supremum proved.
Disjoint-support counterexample with vague compactness and equal information proved.
